message.content: Does anything else read the snapshot time? Check before we ship.

input.description: Find what reads the snapshot time
input.prompt: Find every place in the app and core that reads HostState.updatedAt or the snapshot's arrival time. List each with its file and what it does with it.

content.text:
Two places read it: the machine card (MachineCard.kt) and the stale check in HostSession.kt. Nothing else.
agentId: a7f3c2e10b9d4e58
Only two places read it: the machine card, which is the change, and the stale check in `HostSession`, which already used it. Safe to ship.
